verdict.rationale: Jan ships no client libraries of its own. Its docs instead present the local server at localhost:1337 as an OpenAI-compatible drop-in replacement and say Anthropic SDK clients can be pointed at its /v1/messages endpoint, so developers can call it from Python or JavaScript through third-party SDKs. Missing for 10: first-party Jan SDKs for Python/JavaScript, language-specific code examples beyond curl, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of SDK usage.
